$comment: CANONICAL. The one declaration of the session run-record vocabulary (work types, initiators, end reasons, end sources, bind origins) and the classifier version. See session_work_type.rs for why this is a data file and for the rules on editing it.

work_types.name: post_merge
work_types.description: A session continued from a gate that coord's auto-PR-merged producer registered, run after one of its PRs landed.

work_types.name: pr_fix_red_ci
work_types.description: A PR fixer dispatched because the PR's diagnosis names red CI checks.

work_types.name: pr_fix_conflict
work_types.description: A PR fixer dispatched because the PR's diagnosis names a merge conflict.

work_types.name: admission_stall_fix
work_types.description: A fixer dispatched under the admission_stall_fix dispatch source to unstick a PR the merge train will not admit.

work_types.name: red_main_fix
work_types.description: A fixer dispatched under the red_main_fix dispatch source for a repo whose main branch is red.

work_types.name: merge_shepherd
work_types.description: An unlandable-PR shepherd, dispatched from shepherd tiers 1 to 3 or carrying the merge_shepherd or merge_fixer role.

work_types.name: next_step
work_types.description: A session dispatched under the next_step dispatch source to continue stale work from its resolved next step.

work_types.name: unit_dispatch
work_types.description: A work-unit dispatch (unit_continuation or work_plan) whose continuation names no recognised skill.

work_types.name: condition_autodispatch
work_types.description: A spawn of the condition_autodispatch kind, running a condition group's audit on its schedule or trigger.

work_types.name: operator_page_remediation
work_types.description: A spawn of the operator_page_remediation kind, dispatching the steward that owns a paged condition.

work_types.name: implement_plan
work_types.description: A session whose gate continuation skill, or whose operator's first slash command, is implement-plan.

work_types.name: implement_phase
work_types.description: A session whose gate continuation skill, or whose operator's first slash command, is implement-phase.

work_types.name: vet_imp
work_types.description: A session whose gate continuation skill, or whose operator's first slash command, is vet-imp.

work_types.name: vet_plan
work_types.description: A session whose gate continuation skill, or whose operator's first slash command, is vet-plan.

work_types.name: verify_plan_status
work_types.description: A session whose gate continuation skill, or whose operator's first slash command, is verify-plan-status.

work_types.name: gate_continuation_other
work_types.description: Any other run_skill gate continuation; the raw skill name is kept beside the verdict.

work_types.name: steward
work_types.description: A runner scheduler task running one of the stewards (dev-ops, findings, cleanup, merge-train or return-to-main).

work_types.name: onboarding_audit
work_types.description: A repo-onboarding audit started by the onboarding invoke_spawn.

work_types.name: operator_interactive
work_types.description: A session the operator started whose first slash command, if any, is not a recognised work type.

work_types.name: unknown
work_types.description: Nothing above matched; counted and shown as its own type, never folded into another.
